purpose: Teach: 書面/代理人/不調/派閥/期末/行き先/続行/後押し

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、書面、絶対、で、絶対、通達、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We'll make sure you receive the written statement officially. Thank you for your patience.
lines.style: Professional, measured. Formal opening. Clear enunciation on key procedural words. Steady pace, reassuring without being warm. The voice of someone who has said this many times and means it each time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。容疑者の、本気で、絶対、代理人、絶対、警察、絶対、対応中ですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're handling the suspect's representation through proper police channels.
lines.style: Attentive, cooperative. Slight nod in the voice on the opening 'Yes.' Matching Takeda's measured pace. Demonstrating he's following and engaged without overdoing it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 通信機器の、本気で、絶対、不調、絶対、警察、絶対、対応中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The communication equipment issue — we're working on that right now.
lines.style: Even-toned, matter-of-fact. Brief pause after the dash, then matter-of-fact acknowledgment. No defensiveness. The voice of someone apologizing without performing an apology.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察内、本気で、絶対、派閥、絶対、なく、絶対、一丸、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I appreciate that the department is coordinated — everyone working as one on this.
lines.style: Genuine respect in the tone. Warm but not effusive. Slight emphasis on 'coordinated' — he's noticed and it matters. Steady, collaborative energy.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、期末、絶対、犯罪、絶対、統計、絶対、まとめております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're currently compiling the crime statistics for the end-of-period report.
lines.style: Procedural, slightly formal. Deliberate pacing on the transition to 'crime statistics.' Administrative, efficient. Not rushed but not lingering either.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、容疑者の、絶対、行き先、絶対、追跡中ですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively tracking the suspect's movements and whereabouts.
lines.style: Engaged, professional. Slight emphasis on 'actively' to show diligence. Kenji's tone mirrors Takeda's earlier reassurance — confident without overstatement.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 捜査、本気で、絶対、続行、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The investigation will continue. Thank you for your thoroughness.
lines.style: Firm, resolved. Clean attack on 'investigation.' Steady, purposeful. Gratitude delivered as statement of fact, not apology. The voice of someone committed to follow-through.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。被害者支援、本気で、絶対、後押し、絶対、警察、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're grateful for the police department's support for the victims. It makes a real difference.
lines.style: Warm, sincere. Slight softening on 'grateful' — this one lands differently than the procedural points. Quiet conviction. The voice of someone who has seen what victim support actually means.
